flow.name: Sign In — Enter phone and request OTP
flow.notes: Page loads with heading 'Login' and subheading 'Rupeek Sales App'. Fill 10-digit phone, click Send OTP.

flow.name: Sign In — Enter OTP and login
flow.notes: Fill 4-digit OTP received via SMS, click Login. Redirected to dashboard or check-in screen.

flow.name: Leads List — Navigate to Action Required tab
flow.notes: Navigate directly to leads list, bypassing check-in if the session already exists. Three tabs at top: Action Required, In Progress, Completed.

assertions.label: leads count label showing X of Y leads

flow.name: Leads List — Switch to In Progress tab
flow.notes: Clicking In Progress tab updates the URL to /leads/ongoing/IN_PROGRESS and reloads the list.

flow.name: Leads List — Switch to Completed tab
flow.notes: Clicking Completed tab updates the URL to /leads/ongoing/COMPLETED.

flow.name: Leads List — Switch back to Action Required tab
flow.notes: Return to the primary NOT_STARTED tab.

flow.name: Filter Panel — Open filter drawer
flow.notes: Filter icon is top-right beside the leads count label. Clicking it slides a filter drawer in from the right.

actions.label: Filter icon button at top right of leads list

assertions.label: Hot leads toggle switch inside filter drawer

flow.name: Filter Panel — Close filter drawer without applying
flow.notes: X close icon appears in the filter drawer header. Clicking it dismisses the drawer without applying filters.

actions.label: X close icon in filter drawer header

assertions.label: Action Required tab (filter drawer closed, back to leads list)

flow.name: Lead Detail — Open first lead card
flow.notes: Tap the header area of the first lead card in the list to navigate to its detail page. Requires at least one lead to exist in NOT_STARTED list.

actions.label: First lead card in the Action Required list (contains phone number and customer name)

assertions.label: Dialer call button at the bottom of lead detail page

errorCases.name: Filter returns no leads — empty state shown
